findings.title: Prefix/suffix diff calculation can cross over and throw StringIndexOutOfBoundsException
findings.body: In `verifySafeHtml()`, the `end` loop (`while (end < sanitized.length() && end < value.length() && ...)`) does not stop when `end` reaches `sanitized.length() - start` or `value.length() - start`. When `value` and `sanitized` share identical characters on both sides of a pure insertion or deletion (for example, an extra closing tag like `{0}` vs. `{0}`, or an unclosed tag like `hello` vs. `hello`), `start + end` exceeds the shorter string's length and `substring(start, ... - end)` on line 111 throws a `StringIndexOutOfBoundsException` instead of reporting the illegal HTML.

findings.title: Anchor regex matches non-anchor tags starting with 'a' and skips anchor validation on English files
findings.body: `ANCHOR_PATTERN` (`Pattern.compile("</?a[^>]*>")`) matches any HTML tag whose name starts with `a` (such as `<audio>`, `<applet>`, `<area>`, `<article>`, `<aside>`, `<abbr>`, or `<address>`), not only `<a>` tags. In addition, when `VerifyMessageProperties` runs on an `*_en.properties` file, `englishFile` resolves to the same file, so `englishValue` is identical to `value`; `santizeAnchors()` therefore matches every `<a...>` tag in `messages_en.properties` against itself and removes it before the OWASP sanitizer runs, allowing unsafe attributes on `<a>` tags (e.g., `onclick` or `javascript:` URLs) or tags like `<audio onerror=...>` in English bundles to bypass sanitization completely. Also note that the error message added on line 157 omits both `key` and `file`, making failures hard to locate.

findings.title: Java MessageFormat/ChoiceFormat syntax used in i18next resource bundle for account-ui
findings.body: `error-invalid-multivalued-size` was changed from `Attribute {{0}} must have at least {{1}} and at most {{2}} value(s).` to `Attribute {0} must have at least {1} and at most {2} {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}.`. `account-ui` translates messages on the frontend with `i18next`, which expects double-brace interpolation (`{{0}}`, `{{1}}`, `{{2}}`, as used by all other `error-*` keys in this file) and does not support Java `MessageFormat`/`ChoiceFormat` syntax. As a result, placeholders and the choice pattern will be rendered literally to users.

findings.title: Java MessageFormat/ChoiceFormat syntax used in i18next resource bundle for admin-ui
findings.body: `error-invalid-multivalued-size` was changed from `Attribute {{0}} must have at least {{1}} and at most {{2}} value(s).` to `Attribute {0} must have at least {1} and at most {2} {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}.`. `admin-ui` uses `i18next` with double-brace placeholders (`{{0}}`, `{{1}}`, `{{2}}`) rather than Java `MessageFormat`, so `{0}`, `{1}`, `{2}`, and `{2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}` will not be interpolated and will be displayed verbatim in the UI.

findings.title: Lithuanian translation replaced with Italian text
findings.body: In the Lithuanian (`messages_lt.properties`) account messages bundle, `totpStep1` was replaced with Italian text (`Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:`) instead of a Lithuanian translation.

findings.title: Lithuanian login translation replaced with Italian text
findings.body: In the Lithuanian (`messages_lt.properties`) login messages bundle, `loginTotpStep1` was replaced with Italian text (`Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:`) instead of a Lithuanian translation.
